title: 5 * BLANK is BLANK: BLANK propagates from the right operand too

source.quote: BLANK propagates in a multiplication: if one of the operands is BLANK (), then the result is BLANK ()
source.supports: either operand being BLANK makes the product BLANK

derivation: The right operand is BLANK, so the product is BLANK, whatever the left operand.
